# netcup_server_disk_supported_drivers (Data Source)

The storage drivers a netcup server supports (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_server_disk_supported_drivers" "example" {
  server_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Read-Only

- `supported_drivers` (List of String) Supported storage drivers.
